rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a person who sells goods, especially in a shop; it is normally gender-neutral in Cantonese.

example.english: The salesman in this shop is very polite.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅售貨員好有禮貌。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 sau6 fo3 jyun4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this when the salesman actively promotes or solicits sales, often outside a shop or by visiting customers.

example.english: That salesman is always visiting homes to promote new products.
example.traditional: 嗰個推銷員成日上門推介新產品。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4 seng4 jat6 soeng5 mun4 teoi1 gaai3 san1 caan2 ban2

rows.note: Use this in business or job-title contexts for a sales employee rather than an ordinary shop assistant.

example.english: Our company is hiring an experienced salesman.
example.traditional: 我哋公司請緊一個有經驗嘅銷售員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 cing2 gan2 jat1 go3 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 siu1 sau6 jyun4
